"""Fresh three-snapshot raw-manual differential with immutable local inputs.

Every row executes all three actual cleaner prefixes and the final helper's
length/idempotence checks. Equal prefix bytes plus verified identical suffix
AST/dependencies establish equal inventories. If any prefix differs, all three
actual complete recall functions execute and both numeric profiles are freshly
extracted. No historical inventories, outcomes, or checkpoints are read.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import argparse
import ast
import collections
import copy
import dataclasses
import functools
import hashlib
import importlib.util
import json
import multiprocessing
import os
import subprocess
import sys
import time
from pathlib import Path

HERE = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
ROOT = HERE.parents[2]
MAIN = "86a1f911a338cb071e0ed660d1282714034b6dc4"
REVIEWED = "bb068ca8444ca9445f93b4292788285e770c1e75"
CORPUS = "8f7d60aaced28ee4252b9237f9d6e02360dc34bc"
SOURCE = "src/axiom_encode/harness/source_completeness.py"
METADATA = "src/axiom_encode/harness/manual_locator_metadata.py"
VALIDATOR = "src/axiom_encode/harness/validator_pipeline.py"
PROFILES = ("en-US", "legacy")
sys.path.insert(0, str(ROOT / "src"))


def sha(data):
    return hashlib.sha256(data).hexdigest()


def git_bytes(*arguments):
    return subprocess.check_output(["git", "-c", "core.fsmonitor=false", *arguments], cwd=ROOT)


def definitions(source):
    result = {}
    for node in ast.parse(source).body:
        if isinstance(node, (ast.FunctionDef, ast.AsyncFunctionDef, ast.ClassDef)):
            result[node.name] = node
        elif isinstance(node, ast.Assign):
            for target in node.targets:
                if isinstance(target, ast.Name):
                    result[target.id] = node
        elif isinstance(node, ast.AnnAssign) and isinstance(node.target, ast.Name):
            result[node.target.id] = node
    return result


def reachable(defs, root):
    result, pending = {}, [root]
    while pending:
        name = pending.pop()
        if name in result or name not in defs:
            continue
        node = defs[name]
        result[name] = ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False)
        pending.extend(child.id for child in ast.walk(node) if isinstance(child, ast.Name) and isinstance(child.ctx, ast.Load) and child.id in defs)
    return result


class RemoveManualMasks(ast.NodeTransformer):
    def visit_Assign(self, node):
        if isinstance(node.value, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.value.func, ast.Name) and node.value.func.id == "_without_us_manual_locators":
            return None
        return self.generic_visit(node)

    def visit_If(self, node):
        if isinstance(node.test, ast.Compare) and isinstance(node.test.left, ast.Constant) and node.test.left.value == "/manual/":
            return None
        return self.generic_visit(node)


def split_function(source):
    full = definitions(source)["authoritative_numeric_recall_text"]
    split = next(index for index, node in enumerate(full.body) if isinstance(node, ast.If) and isinstance(node.test, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.test.func, ast.Attribute) and isinstance(node.test.func.value, ast.Name) and node.test.func.value.id == "_US_CORPUS_CITATION_PATH")
    prefix = copy.deepcopy(full)
    prefix.name = "_audit_prefix"
    prefix.body = prefix.body[:split + 1] + [ast.Return(value=ast.Name(id="cleaned", ctx=ast.Load()))]
    suffix = ast.parse("def _audit_suffix(cleaned, corpus_citation_path):\n    return cleaned\n").body[0]
    suffix.body = copy.deepcopy(full.body[split + 1:])
    assert not any(isinstance(node, ast.Name) and isinstance(node.ctx, ast.Load) and node.id == "source_text" for node in ast.walk(suffix)), "Suffix reads original input"
    generated = ast.Module(body=[prefix, suffix], type_ignores=[])
    ast.fix_missing_locations(generated)
    return generated, suffix


def pipeline_proof(sources):
    shared, suffixes, computations, imports = {}, {}, {}, {}
    for name, source in sources.items():
        defs = definitions(source)
        stripped = copy.deepcopy(defs)
        root = "authoritative_numeric_recall_text"
        stripped[root] = RemoveManualMasks().visit(stripped[root])
        shared[name] = reachable(stripped, root)
        _, suffix = split_function(source)
        defs["_audit_suffix"] = suffix
        suffixes[name] = reachable(defs, "_audit_suffix")
        computations[name] = reachable(defs, "source_states_explicit_computation")
        imports[name] = {ast.dump(node, include_attributes=False) for node in ast.parse(source).body if isinstance(node, (ast.Import, ast.ImportFrom))}
    for name in ("reviewed", "final"):
        assert shared["main"] == shared[name], f"Shared recall dependencies changed: {name}"
        assert suffixes["main"] == suffixes[name], f"Actual suffix dependencies changed: {name}"
        assert computations["main"] == computations[name], f"Explicit computation dependencies changed: {name}"
        assert imports["main"] <= imports[name], f"Main import removed: {name}"
    return {"snapshots": list(sources), "all_equal": True, "shared_recall_definitions": sorted(shared["main"]), "shared_suffix_definitions": sorted(suffixes["main"]), "shared_explicit_computation_definitions": sorted(computations["main"]), "imports_main_subset_of_reviewed_and_final": True, "suffix_ast_sha256": sha(json.dumps(suffixes["main"], sort_keys=True).encode()), "shared_recall_ast_sha256": sha(json.dumps(shared["main"], sort_keys=True).encode())}


def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module


def initialize(output):
    global MODULES, PREFIX, RECALL, HELPERS, EXTRACT
    output = Path(output)
    MODULES, PREFIX, RECALL, HELPERS = {}, {}, {}, {}
    for name in ("main", "reviewed", "final"):
        module = load(f"r6_frozen_{name}", output / f"{name}-source.py")
        metadata = output / f"{name}-metadata.py"
        if metadata.exists():
            frozen = load(f"r6_frozen_{name}_metadata", metadata)
            for key, value in vars(frozen).items():
                if key.isupper():
                    setattr(module, key, value)
        original = getattr(module, "_without_us_manual_locators", lambda text, *, corpus_citation_path: text)

        @functools.lru_cache(maxsize=4096)
        def helper(text, citation, _original=original, _name=name):
            masked = _original(text, corpus_citation_path=citation)
            assert len(masked) == len(text), f"Helper length failed: {_name}, {citation}"
            if _name == "final":
                assert _original(masked, corpus_citation_path=citation) == masked, f"Helper idempotence failed: {citation}"
            digits = tuple(index for index, (before, after) in enumerate(zip(text, masked)) if before.isdigit() and before != after)
            return masked, digits

        HELPERS[name] = helper
        module._without_us_manual_locators = lambda text, *, corpus_citation_path, _helper=helper: _helper(text, corpus_citation_path)[0]
        generated, _ = split_function((output / f"{name}-source.py").read_bytes())
        exec(compile(generated, "<actual-cleaner-pipeline-split>", "exec"), vars(module))
        MODULES[name] = module
        PREFIX[name] = functools.lru_cache(maxsize=4096)(lambda body, citation, _module=module: _module._audit_prefix(body, corpus_citation_path=citation))
        RECALL[name] = functools.lru_cache(maxsize=4096)(lambda body, citation, _module=module: _module.authoritative_numeric_recall_text(body, corpus_citation_path=citation))
    from axiom_encode.harness.validator_pipeline import extract_typed_numeric_inventory_occurrences_from_text

    EXTRACT = functools.lru_cache(maxsize=8192)(lambda text, profile: tuple(dataclasses.asdict(item) for item in extract_typed_numeric_inventory_occurrences_from_text(text, profile=profile)))


def semantic(inventory):
    return collections.Counter(json.dumps({key: value for key, value in item.items() if key not in {"raw", "start", "end"}}, sort_keys=True) for item in inventory)


def delta(old_inventory, new_inventory, body, profile):
    removed, added = semantic(old_inventory) - semantic(new_inventory), semantic(new_inventory) - semantic(old_inventory)
    if not added and not removed:
        return None
    old_values, new_values = (collections.Counter(item["value"] for item in inventory) for inventory in (old_inventory, new_inventory))
    values = set(new_values - old_values) | set(old_values - new_values)
    return {
        "added_typed": [dict(json.loads(item), count=count) for item, count in added.items()],
        "removed_typed": [dict(json.loads(item), count=count) for item, count in removed.items()],
        "added_occurrences": dict(new_values - old_values), "removed_occurrences": dict(old_values - new_values),
        "new_demands": sorted(set(new_values) - set(old_values)), "removed_demands": sorted(set(old_values) - set(new_values)),
        "before_inventory": [item["value"] for item in old_inventory], "final_inventory": [item["value"] for item in new_inventory],
        "contexts": [dict(item, context=body[max(0, item["start"] - 180):item["end"] + 260]) for item in EXTRACT(body, profile) if item["value"] in values],
    }


def evaluate(task):
    path, line, raw, row = task
    started = time.perf_counter()
    body, citation = row.get("body") or "", row["citation_path"]
    helpers = {name: helper(body, citation) for name, helper in HELPERS.items()}
    if not MODULES["final"]._US_CORPUS_CITATION_PATH.match(citation):
        assert all(masked == body for masked, _digits in helpers.values()), f"Non-US helper changed source: {citation}"
    prefixes = {name: prefix(body, citation) for name, prefix in PREFIX.items()}
    equal = len(set(prefixes.values())) == 1
    new_masks = sorted(set(helpers["final"][1]) - set(helpers["reviewed"][1]))
    result = {
        "file": path, "line": line, "citation": citation, "jurisdiction": row["jurisdiction"], "row_sha256": sha(raw),
        "proof": "equal_actual_prefixes_and_identical_suffix" if equal else "actual_full_recall_and_both_profiles_fresh_extraction",
        "prefix_sha256": {name: sha(prefix.encode()) for name, prefix in prefixes.items()},
        "helper_sha256": {name: sha(value[0].encode()) for name, value in helpers.items()},
        "helper_available": {"main": False, "reviewed": True, "final": True},
        "helper_masked_digit_counts": {name: len(value[1]) for name, value in helpers.items()},
        "helper_final_length_and_idempotence": True, "helper_non_us_no_op": not MODULES["final"]._US_CORPUS_CITATION_PATH.match(citation),
        "newly_masked_digit_positions_vs_reviewed": new_masks,
    }
    if new_masks:
        result["new_mask_contexts"] = [{"position": index, "digit": body[index], "context": body[max(0, index - 180):index + 260]} for index in new_masks]
    if not equal:
        recalls = {name: function(body, citation) for name, function in RECALL.items()}
        for name, text in recalls.items():
            assert text == MODULES[name]._audit_suffix(prefixes[name], citation), f"Full recall/split mismatch: {name}, {citation}"
        result["recall_sha256"] = {name: sha(text.encode()) for name, text in recalls.items()}
        result["inventory_sha256"], result["changes"] = {}, {}
        for profile in PROFILES:
            inventories = {name: EXTRACT(text, profile) for name, text in recalls.items()}
            result["inventory_sha256"][profile] = {name: sha(json.dumps(inventory, sort_keys=True).encode()) for name, inventory in inventories.items()}
            for baseline in ("main", "reviewed"):
                change = delta(inventories[baseline], inventories["final"], body, profile)
                if change:
                    result["changes"][f"{baseline}_to_final/{profile}"] = dict(change, citation=citation, file=path, line=line, heading=row.get("heading"))
    result["seconds"] = time.perf_counter() - started
    return result


def verified_manifest():
    manifest = json.loads((HERE / "corpus-manifest.json").read_bytes())
    assert len(manifest) == 231 and sum(item["rows"] for item in manifest) == 68848
    for item in manifest:
        path = HERE / "input" / item["file"]
        data = path.read_bytes()
        assert sha(data) == item["sha256"], f"Input hash changed: {item['file']}"
        assert sum(bool(raw.strip()) for raw in data.splitlines()) == item["rows"], f"Input count changed: {item['file']}"
    return manifest


def main():
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser(description=__doc__)
    parser.add_argument("--output", type=Path, required=True)
    parser.add_argument("--workers", type=int, choices=(1, 2, 4), default=1)
    parser.add_argument("--limit", type=int, default=0, help="Preparatory smoke test only; never labelled full corpus")
    parser.add_argument("--shape", choices=("raw", "sole-page"), default="raw", help="A synthetic sole Page 1 composition of every US body is supplementary evidence")
    args = parser.parse_args()
    print(json.dumps({"output": args.output.name, "runner": Path(__file__).name}), flush=True)
    started = time.perf_counter()
    output = args.output.resolve()
    assert output.is_relative_to(HERE) and not output.exists()
    sources = {"main": git_bytes("show", f"{MAIN}:{SOURCE}"), "reviewed": git_bytes("show", f"{REVIEWED}:{SOURCE}"), "final": (ROOT / SOURCE).read_bytes()}
    metadata = {"reviewed": git_bytes("show", f"{REVIEWED}:{METADATA}"), "final": (ROOT / METADATA).read_bytes()}
    validator = (ROOT / VALIDATOR).read_bytes()
    assert validator == git_bytes("show", f"{MAIN}:{VALIDATOR}") == git_bytes("show", f"{REVIEWED}:{VALIDATOR}"), "Extractor changed"
    proof = pipeline_proof(sources)
    manifest = verified_manifest()
    expected_rows = 68848 if args.shape == "raw" else 47238
    info = {"main": MAIN, "reviewed_head": REVIEWED, "corpus_commit": CORPUS, "source_sha256": {name: sha(data) for name, data in sources.items()}, "metadata_sha256": {name: sha(data) for name, data in metadata.items()}, "validator_sha256": sha(validator), "corpus_manifest_sha256": sha((HERE / "corpus-manifest.json").read_bytes()), "files": len(manifest), "python": sys.version, "workers": args.workers, "profiles": PROFILES, "runner_sha256": sha(Path(__file__).read_bytes()), "historical_inventory_rows": 0, "resumed_rows": 0, "limit": args.limit, "shape": args.shape, "threads": {name: os.environ.get(name) for name in ("OMP_NUM_THREADS", "OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS", "MKL_NUM_THREADS", "VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS", "NUMEXPR_NUM_THREADS", "OMP_WAIT_POLICY")}}
    output.mkdir(parents=True)
    for name, data in sources.items():
        (output / f"{name}-source.py").write_bytes(data)
    for name, data in metadata.items():
        (output / f"{name}-metadata.py").write_bytes(data)
    (output / "provenance.json").write_text(json.dumps(info, indent=2) + "\n")
    (output / "pipeline-proof.json").write_text(json.dumps(proof, indent=2) + "\n")
    proof_counts, jurisdictions = collections.Counter(), collections.Counter()
    seen, returned, processed = set(), set(), 0
    metric_names = ("changed_inventories", "new_demands", "removed_demands", "added_occurrences", "removed_occurrences", "added_typed", "removed_typed")
    counts = {f"{baseline}_to_final/{profile}": collections.Counter({key: 0 for key in metric_names}) for baseline in ("main", "reviewed") for profile in PROFILES}
    changes = {key: [] for key in counts}
    new_mask_rows, new_mask_digits, null_bodies = 0, 0, 0

    def tasks():
        nonlocal null_bodies
        issued = 0
        for item in manifest:
            for line, raw in enumerate((HERE / "input" / item["file"]).read_bytes().splitlines(), 1):
                if not raw.strip():
                    continue
                if args.limit and issued >= args.limit:
                    return
                row = json.loads(raw)
                if args.shape == "sole-page":
                    if not row["jurisdiction"].startswith("us-"):
                        continue
                    row = dict(row, body="Page 1\n\n" + (row.get("body") or ""))
                key = item["file"], line
                assert key not in seen and "/manual/" in row["citation_path"]
                seen.add(key)
                null_bodies += row.get("body") is None
                issued += 1
                yield item["file"], line, raw, row

    print(json.dumps({"started": True, "expected_rows": args.limit or expected_rows, "profiles": PROFILES, "workers": args.workers, "fresh": True, "source_sha256": info["source_sha256"]}), flush=True)
    with (output / "rows.jsonl").open("w") as dest, multiprocessing.Pool(args.workers, initialize, (str(output),)) as pool:
        for item in pool.imap_unordered(evaluate, tasks(), chunksize=16):
            key = item["file"], item["line"]
            assert key not in returned
            returned.add(key)
            dest.write(json.dumps(item, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
            processed += 1
            proof_counts[item["proof"]] += 1
            jurisdictions[item["jurisdiction"]] += 1
            new_mask_rows += bool(item["newly_masked_digit_positions_vs_reviewed"])
            new_mask_digits += len(item["newly_masked_digit_positions_vs_reviewed"])
            for comparison, change in item.get("changes", {}).items():
                changes[comparison].append(change)
                count = counts[comparison]
                count["changed_inventories"] += 1
                for key in ("new_demands", "removed_demands"):
                    count[key] += len(change[key])
                for key in ("added_occurrences", "removed_occurrences"):
                    count[key] += sum(change[key].values())
                for key in ("added_typed", "removed_typed"):
                    count[key] += sum(value["count"] for value in change[key])
            if processed % 500 == 0:
                dest.flush()
                print(f"{processed}/{args.limit or expected_rows} rows in {time.perf_counter() - started:.1f}s", flush=True)
    assert seen == returned and processed == (args.limit or expected_rows), "Missing or duplicate results"
    assert sha((ROOT / SOURCE).read_bytes()) == info["source_sha256"]["final"], "Final source changed during audit"
    assert sha((ROOT / METADATA).read_bytes()) == info["metadata_sha256"]["final"], "Final metadata changed during audit"
    assert sha((ROOT / VALIDATOR).read_bytes()) == info["validator_sha256"], "Extractor changed during audit"
    assert verified_manifest() == manifest
    limitation = "Raw manual bodies only" if args.shape == "raw" else "Synthetic sole-page composition of every US row only"
    summary = dict(info, rows=processed, full_corpus=not args.limit and args.shape == "raw", full_us_sole_page=not args.limit and args.shape == "sole-page", null_body_rows=null_bodies, proof_counts=dict(proof_counts), jurisdictions=dict(sorted(jurisdictions.items())), helper_final_length_passed_rows=processed, helper_final_idempotence_passed_rows=processed, newly_masked_rows_vs_reviewed=new_mask_rows, newly_masked_digit_positions_vs_reviewed=new_mask_digits, comparisons={key: dict(count) for key, count in counts.items()}, all_completion_guards_passed=True, elapsed_seconds=time.perf_counter() - started, limitations=limitation + "; no composed books, signing events, historical outcomes, or full artifact-completeness evaluation. Absence of new masks/removals does not prove every preexisting mask is nonoperative.")
    for comparison, items in changes.items():
        with (output / f"changes-{comparison.replace('/', '-')}.jsonl").open("w") as dest:
            for item in sorted(items, key=lambda item: (item["file"], item["line"])):
                dest.write(json.dumps(item, separators=(",", ":")) + "\n")
    summary["output_sha256"] = {path.name: sha(path.read_bytes()) for path in output.glob("*.jsonl")}
    (output / "summary.json").write_text(json.dumps(summary, indent=2) + "\n")
    print(json.dumps(summary, indent=2), flush=True)


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
